bio: This spot on a corner in Roma offers a few design nods to its former life as a mechanic's shop (spy the tool cabinets doing double duty as the host stand and service station). The industrial chic vibe is hip yet casual, just like the contemporary, creative Mexican menu with an evolving collection of snacks, small plates, and shareable main dishes. There's something for everyone here, where you'll discover distinctive dishes like a savory, chaya leaf-infused churro sided by warm, aged Cotija cheese sauce. Wood-fired whole chicken with a bitter orange glaze and homemade achiote paste is good for a group, but don't sleep on dessert. Pecan pie with maple honey, vanilla ice cream, and soft Mexican mountain cheese is a can't miss....
